build_pipeline_with_config: build a data processing pipeline using PipelineConfig with SourceConfig, Pipe, and SinkConfig
test_build_pipeline_diagnostic_mode: test that build_pipeline returns _ProfilePipeline when SPDL_PIPELINE_DIAGNOSTIC_MODE env var is set
